items.title: Jimmy Lewis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: So I created a tune to fit every tap that they made on the floor... And so they liked it so well, they wanted to write it up.

ctx.x: Oh man, we get out there, now the Nicholas Brothers didn’t have any music. So they [inaudible] bass. So I created a tune to fit every tap that they made on the floor. Oh, man, it was the bass, and doing all that stuff with slides and tumbles and all those things. And so they liked it so well, they wanted to write it up. I can’t even remember what it was now. But it fit them just like it was a glove.
That’s really interesting how the dance and music are so intertwined.
